description: ODC: warnings that ONLY the ODC verifier emits can be declared in expectedMessages. Two global events with no trigger or handler: the private one gets PrivateUnusedGlobalEvent and UnusedGlobalEvent, the public one only UnusedGlobalEvent. These ids do not exist in the O11 lists (catalog/verify-messages-*.json); the ODC lane validates against catalog/odc/verify-messages-<version>.json, generated from the installed ODC Studio by `anvil-odc verify-catalog --out`. Before this the job was refused at read time ('unknown expectedMessages id') and an ODC job with these warnings never came out accepted:true.

expectedMessages.why: Private event with no local handler: the ODC-only warning that this job exists to declare.
Event with no trigger (no TriggerGlobalNode triggers it): ODC-only warning.
The public event also has no trigger; being public, it does not ask for a local handler.
